Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is an affinity purification (co-IP) to identify the receptor for C1QTNF4. The primary biological variable is the addition of the C1QTNF4 ligand versus a GFP control. Mapping is kept at the parent level (ligand_stimulation) as C1QTNF4 is a novel ligand and does not fit into the specific fine-grained classes like cytokines or growth factors.
